description: What the installed Claude Code binaries answered on 2026-10-24 (T101), each run with HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set to fresh empty owner-only directories (no account, no network sign-in), DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, and PATH only: `--version`, and `auth status` signed out. The throwaway paths are redacted. `auth status` wrote `.claude.json` (no oauthAccount), a `.claude.json.lock` directory, and `backups/` in the config directory, nothing in HOME. Every unit of the code the identity reader and the get_usage reader rely on is 2.1.308's in 2.1.309 and 2.1.310 but for minified names.
